app.name: Receipts
preview.title: Preview mode
preview.body: You are looking at the interface outside Anna, so nothing here has been checked against a real CV. Install Receipts to run a real match.
onboarding.heading: Match your CV to any job, without making things up.
onboarding.body: Paste a job posting and Receipts checks every requirement against your real CV, shows you the evidence, then writes bullets and a cover letter using only what you can prove.
onboarding.point1: Every requirement shows the CV line that backs it.
onboarding.point2: Gaps are named plainly, so you can prepare for them.
onboarding.point3: Anything your CV cannot prove never gets written.
cv.add.heading: Add your CV
cv.add.body: Upload a PDF or DOCX, or paste the text. It is saved in your Anna storage and never leaves your account.
cv.add.dropHint: Drop a file here, or choose one. 2 MB maximum.
cv.add.pastePlaceholder: Paste the whole CV, including dates and employers.
cv.preview.heading: Check how we read your CV
cv.preview.body: Every line gets a number. Matches cite these numbers, so a misread line is worth fixing now.
cv.warning.multi_column_suspected: This looks like a two-column layout, so lines may be out of order. Check them, or paste the text instead.
cv.warning.tables_flattened: Tables were flattened into single lines.
cv.warning.truncated: Your CV was long, so the end was left out of the match.
match.new.heading: Paste a job posting
match.new.body: The whole posting works best — requirements, responsibilities, the lot.
match.new.urlLabel: Or paste a link to the posting
match.new.needCv: Add your CV first — a match needs something to check against.
progress.stage.match: Looking for evidence in your CV
map.missingNote: These are worth preparing for, not hiding.
map.noPosting: This match has no saved posting title.
tailor.heading: Suggested bullets
tailor.body: Each suggestion rewrites one of your lines. The source line is always shown, so you can see exactly what changed.
tailor.dropped: We couldn't strengthen this line without adding facts that aren't in your CV.
tailor.empty: No line in your CV needed rewriting for this posting.
letter.heading: Cover letter
letter.body: Every paragraph lists the CV lines it stands on.
export.unverified: {count} line(s) you edited could not be traced back to your CV. The document says so too — check them before you send it.
tracker.heading: Matches
tracker.empty: Your matches will appear here. Paste a job posting to start.
tracker.deleteConfirmBody: The match, its bullets and its letter go with it. Running it again means another analysis.
settings.heading: Your data
settings.body: Your CV and every match are stored in your Anna account. Receipts uses no external services.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: This deletes your CV and all matches from Anna. It can't be undone.
summary.sentence: {evidenced} of {total} requirements have evidence in your CV.
common.exampleNote: This is a recorded example. Add your CV to run a real match.
error.file_too_large: This file is over 2 MB. Export a smaller PDF or paste the text.
error.unreadable_file: We couldn't read text from this file. It may be a scanned image. Paste the text instead.
error.cv_too_short: This CV looks too short to match against. Add your experience and try again.
error.no_requirements_found: This text doesn't look like a job posting. Paste the full posting, including requirements.
error.model_output_invalid: The analysis didn't finish cleanly. Run it again — your inputs are saved.
error.sampling_unavailable: Anna couldn't run the model right now. Check your credits or try again in a minute.
error.upload_expired: The upload timed out. Choose the file again.
error.invalid_args: Something about that request didn't line up. Run the match again.
error.internal_error: The engine hit an unexpected problem. Run it again.
error.host_unavailable: Anna couldn't reach the Receipts engine. Check that your Anna Agent is online.
error.url_fetch_failed: This page didn't let us read it. Paste the posting text instead.
error.save_failed: The match finished but Anna couldn't save it. It is on screen — copy what you need before you close the window.
error.export_failed: The file didn't reach your downloads. Export it again.
error.export_empty: Accept a bullet or write a letter first — there is nothing to put in the document yet.
error.cv_changed: Your CV changed after this match was made. Run the match again before tailoring it.
